tasks.label: 编译并运行 C 文件
编译并运行多文件 C 工程
tasks.command: chcp 65001 > $null; $env:Path = 'C:\msys64\mingw64\bin;' + $env:Path; $dir = '${fileDirname}'; $main = '${file}'; if ((Split-Path $dir -Leaf) -eq 'Day11') { if (($main -notlike '*_main.c') -and ($main -notlike '*_homework.c')) { $cands = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $dir -Filter *_main.c); if ($cands.Count -eq 1) { $main = $cands[0].FullName } }; $mods = Get-ChildItem -Path $dir -Filter *.c | Where-Object { $_.FullName -ne $main -and $_.Name -notlike '*_main.c' -and $_.Name -notlike '*_homework.c' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; $all = @($main) + @($mods); $out = Join-Path $dir ([System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($main) + '.exe'); gcc -Wall -g -finput-charset=UTF-8 -fexec-charset=UTF-8 $all -o $out } else { $out = Join-Path $dir ([System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($main) + '.exe'); gcc -Wall -g -finput-charset=UTF-8 -fexec-charset=UTF-8 $main -o $out }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & $out }
